about: Method 2: hand-made reductions of one model each (MODEL-REPLACEMENT-OBJ-67; decided for the project on 17 November 2026). Method 1 is the conversion every model gets (the converter's profile reduction, planar merge or meshopt+merge by config/mesh-methods.json, and the rows of config/visual-recipes.json). A model with a row here is drawn by method 2 wherever it is placed (every CHIM frame and every CHIM room), keyed by its model path and the SHA-256 of its NIF file, so only that model type changes; collision, light and flames stay the original's. Method 1 stays selectable: per model ("method": 1 in its row) and for the whole build (AMIWIND_MODEL_METHOD=1). No game data is in this file: a row holds numbers only (the construction, which source parts to keep, the bake settings), and the builder makes the mesh and its textures from the user's own game files at build time (tools/model_method2.py, tools/lantern_rebuild.py, tools/hand_made_kinds.py). A row is used (method 2) when its texture memory added, as the engine holds it (a picture with its mip levels), is at most the mesh memory it saves, or a small growth with the faces down; a row that fails it stays on method 1, recorded with its numbers, until the maintainer decides (MODEL-REDUCTION-BATCHES-67). Each row records where it came from (source: batch, date, author), its counts (before, change, total) and its measured A/B.

counts.about: triangles and distinct positions of the drawn mesh: the original as the converter reads it, the rebuild, and the change; faces_before = the faces one placement draws today (v0.0.67-dev1 rooms); faces_after: measured on the first build that carries the row

meshes/l/light_com_lantern_02.nif.ab: faces one placement draws, through the converter (rooms' and frames' profiles): 203 -> 58. Intake rule (texture memory added at most the mesh memory saved): the baked panels (one 256 x 64 picture with its mip levels, 21,760 bytes per model kind) exceed the about 15,134 bytes of mesh saved by about 6,600 bytes, before the two source textures it no longer draws (up to 10,880 bytes if no other model in the area uses them); the frosted panels (5,440 bytes) pass. So the row takes the frosted panels (17 November 2026, by the intake rule: judged by memory as the engine holds it), until the maintainer decides otherwise; the baked panels stay selectable ("panels": "baked", or AMIWIND_METHOD2_PANELS=baked for an A/B). Frame rate not measured yet (both ways: AMIWIND_MODEL_METHOD=1 against the default).

recipe.units: quake (Morrowind units x 0.25), Z up, texture v as in the OBJ convention (1 - v of the NIF): the numbers as the checkpoint measured them; tools/lantern_rebuild.py converts at one place each way
